newsitem.title: USA: PartnerRe sees cuts in Q2 volume of business.
newsitem.headline: PartnerRe sees cuts in Q2 volume of business.

text.p: PartnerRe Ltd said Monday that prices for castotrophe reinsurance outside North American have continued to fall and that it will likely feel the effect of the current competitive climate in castastrophe reinsurance.
The company reported first quarter fully diluted operating earnings of $1.14 a share, down from $1.11 a share in the 1996 quarter.

"We expect to see a reduction in the volume of business written in the second quarter, part of which can be attributed to the strength of the U.S. dollar," the company said in a statement accompanying its first quarter report.
